explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/310 with the positive answer (via Bloom, as observed by Liu–Sawhney). For each α > 0 there is C such that every A ⊆ [1,N] with |A| ≥ αN has a subset whose reciprocal sum is a/b with 0 < a ≤ b ≤ C. The empty S cannot be a witness, since a > 0. Formal proof linked.
